title: Paddle wheelers: side-wheel and stern-wheel boats
summary: Which riverboats were excursion boats and how side-wheel boats turn compared with stern-wheelers.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Well, when you went on the boat and you started to work, did you go on a trip right away or what?

No, you see, the boat was an ex-question boat runner. You didn't go take them on the boat trips when you were in the Orleans. Oh, who saw the boats? Well, you saw the big, what do you call it, the Elk, the President. The President. Well, it's a big, you didn't go on there, did you?
We went on it, yeah. We went on it, but this is a new boat. Yeah, I know.

Well, the old boat was the same way. The big dance, nice dance floor. We saw that. Yeah. Nice dance floor. Nice dance floor, see. If I thought of us, you'd mention my name, they know all of us. See, I'm one of the first ones to play. See, now they had the stream of Sydney down there then. See? A big wheel in the back, pedal wheel right in the back. See, this is a side wheel boat that they got there now. Yeah. Two wheels on each side, see. See, now this boat with a side wheel boat, that's one of your first boats, you know. The side, that's the oldest boat. It's not new. See, the wheel on the back, that's the newest. You have two of your first boats. Turn down the boat.

But the side wheel boats, where the boats can turn right around right in the middle of the river. See, one wheel will be going frontwards and the other will be going backwards, you know. And they can turn right around in the spot. That's the way they turn the boats, you see. But the back wheel of the boat is turned by a propeller, by a thing in the back, you know. what time did you do it?
